scope: Full browser workflows; current native ABI11 frozen builds; component ablations, controls and repeats
head: a590b92

environment.timedScope: Planner worker creation through all partition completion; includes worker/WASM initialization, planning and warmup. Excludes browser launch, initial page loading, pool-module import and builds.

interpretation.timeout: Right-censored: incomplete at recorded timeout, no optimality claim. Do not rank by completed partitions.
interpretation.sameObjective: Independently reconstructed result equals stored reference optimum; expected score never injected as incumbent.
interpretation.foodPlanning: WAR inputs contain the same 6 food candidates. GCD2.50 produces4 tasks andGCD2.48 produces6; this is planner filtering, not a changed input food set. N10 vs W10 differs only in targetGcd.
interpretation.archivedExperimentalFiles: Frozen CLI dependency sources include old integer experiment files solely for replay; they are known incorrect diagnostic code, not accepted algorithms.
interpretation.adoption: No production algorithm changed or deployed. Rejected integer model not included in this native comparison.
interpretation.restartControl: restart-limit4 is a per-partition limit and also enables intermediate candidate sharing; compared with baseline0 this is a combined sharing+restart experiment, not pure restart isolation.
interpretation.repetition: Most component screens are single runs; only explicit repeat rows are repeats. Small differences do not establish stable benefit.

changes: Disable full-search TEN tree index only

ablation.name: native-neither

Disable full-search hard-constraint split pressure only
Same Pareto algorithm via JS instead of native backend

Disable primary-stat and weapon split priority, retain upper-bound model
Disable correlated linear upper evaluation only, retain CRT bands and split weights
Disable primary indexing/order and related upper together; preserve CRT partition and budget
Disable native secondary budget upper tightening only; retain correlated bound and all feasibility checks.
